supports.excerpt:
### Local variables ​

- d3.local - declares a new local variable.
- local.set - set a local variable’s value.
- local.get - get a local variable’s value.
- local.remove - delete a local variable.
- local.toString - get the property identifier of a local variable.

### Namespaces ​

- d3.namespace - qualify a prefixed XML name, such as “xlink:href”.
- d3.namespaces - the built-in XML namespaces.

## d3-shape ​

skill_drafts.name: Declare and Manage Local Variables
skill_drafts.description: Create, set, retrieve, and remove scoped local variables in D3 contexts. Use when you need isolated state that does not pollute global scope or require explicit lifecycle management.
contraindications: Global configuration or shared data across unrelated components
Data that must survive component unmounting
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Declare local variable', 'detail': 'Call d3.local() to create a new local variable instance'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Assign value', 'detail': 'Call local.set(node, value) to bind a value to a specific DOM node or selection context'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Retrieve value', 'detail': 'Call local.get(node) to access the stored value from the same context'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Inspect identifier', 'detail': 'Call local.toString() to get the property identifier for debugging or introspection'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Clean up', 'detail': 'Call local.remove(node) to delete the variable when the context is no longer needed'}
triggers: Need to store data bound to a specific D3 selection or DOM node
Require isolated state without global side effects
constraints: Local variables are bound to specific DOM nodes or execution contexts
Values are not automatically serialized or persisted
Removal must be explicit to avoid memory leaks in long-running applications
cautions: Ensure local.remove() is called when context is destroyed to prevent memory leaks
Local variables are not accessible outside their bound context
Do not use for data that needs to be shared across unrelated D3 selections
output_contract: Local variable is created, assigned a value, retrieved on demand, and removed when no longer needed; no global namespace pollution. Caller receives isolated state bound to the specified context.

metadata.prompt: Use d3.local to declare a new local variable. Call local.set(node, value) to assign a value to a specific DOM node or selection context. Call local.get(node) to retrieve the value. Call local.remove(node) to delete the variable from that context. Call local.toString() to inspect the property identifier. This pattern ensures state remains bound to its execution context without affecting global scope.

skill_drafts.name: Qualify and Resolve XML Namespaces
skill_drafts.description: Resolve prefixed XML names (e.g., 'xlink:href') to their full namespace URIs and access built-in namespace definitions. Use when working with SVG, XML attributes, or DOM elements that require namespace qualification.
skill_drafts.objective: Resolve XML namespace prefixes to URIs
applicable_signals: Working with SVG elements or XML documents
contraindications: Working with plain HTML attributes without namespace prefixes
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': "Check if the name is prefixed (contains ':')", 'detail': 'Identify the prefix and local name components'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Call d3.namespace(prefixed_name) to resolve the prefix', 'detail': "Returns an object with 'space' (namespace URI) and 'local' (local name) properties"}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Optionally consult d3.namespaces for available built-in namespace definitions', 'detail': 'Use to verify or discover standard namespace URIs'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Use the resolved namespace URI and local name for DOM or SVG operations', 'detail': 'Apply to setAttribute, createElementNS, or other namespace-aware methods'}
triggers: Setting or reading SVG/XML attributes with namespace prefixes
Need to look up standard namespace URIs (e.g., xlink, svg, xmlns)
Qualifying element or attribute names for DOM or SVG operations
constraints: Prefix must be registered in d3.namespaces or a custom namespace map
Input must be a valid prefixed name string (format: 'prefix:localName')
cautions: Ensure the prefix is recognized; unknown prefixes will not resolve correctly
Built-in namespaces are limited; custom namespaces may require manual registration
output_contract: Returns an object with 'space' (full namespace URI) and 'local' (local name) properties. Prefixed name is correctly resolved and ready for namespace-aware DOM or SVG operations.

examples.notes: Resolves the xlink prefix to its standard namespace URI

examples.output: Object containing built-in namespace mappings (xlink, svg, xmlns, etc.)
examples.notes: Provides reference for available standard namespaces

metadata.prompt: Use d3.namespace() to qualify a prefixed XML name by resolving its prefix to the full namespace URI. Use d3.namespaces to access the built-in XML namespace registry. This ensures SVG and XML attributes are correctly qualified for DOM operations.
